verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API with OpenAPI spec, endpoints for creating/editing/querying objects, plus an official MCP server and CLI for headless automation, giving AI-native users a documented public API to drive the product. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of API robustness, and the OpenAPI spec isn't hosted at a discoverable standard path (probe 404s) despite doc references, only vendor docs confirm functionality.
